in_english.name: Aghnia
in_english.long_meaning: The name Aghnia originates from the Arabic root 'غ ن ي' (gh-n-y), which conveys the meanings of wealth, richness, and prosperity. In Islamic tradition, the name Aghnia signifies a person who is blessed with material abundance and spiritual richness. The Quranic reference to 'ghaniyy' (rich) in Surah Al-Furqan, verse 2, highlights the concept of spiritual richness and self-sufficiency through faith
